subject: [PATCH v3 2/5] mm: don't PTE-batch a swap-in of a folio with a hardware-poisoned page

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Expressed enthusiasm for the patch and added a Reviewed-by tag without raising any concerns.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a bug in the large-folio batching path of the mm module, where a hardware-poisoned page can be mapped without being checked for poisoning. The fix involves skipping batching for anon folios containing a poisoned page and letting each page take its own fault.
